texts.name: How to work
texts.text: How to work

texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 4 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand color and the two typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and a default Text Field. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the photos, the social and payment logos and the icons from 04 · Media. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 4 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand color and the two typefaces in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button and a default Text Field. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the photos, the social and payment logos and the icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.

It’s become my favorite go-to shirt.” · Posted on August 14, 2023 Alex M. · 4 — “The t-shirt exceeded my expectations! The colors are vibrant and the print quality is top-notch. The minimalistic yet stylish pattern caught my eye, and the fit is perfect. I can see the designer’s touch in every aspect of this shirt.” · Posted on August 16, 2023 Olivia P. · 4 — “As a UI/UX enthusiast, I value simplicity and functionality. This t-shirt not only represents those principles but also feels great to wear. It’s evident that the designer poured their creativity into making this t-shirt stand out.” · Posted on August 17, 2023 Liam K. · 4 — “This t-shirt is a fusion of comfort and creativity.
